# 2026-06-24 HPO normalization (CTD convention): the denormalised gene_symbol /
# phenotype_name / disease_name copies were removed from HPO's association tables
# (the 2026-05-16 C5 entries are now FIXED and dropped). The phenotype masters were
# also MERGED on disk into a single full-coverage `phenotype_master_table` (19,389
# terms + name + ontology metadata), so phenotype_id now resolves cleanly to a
# `_master_table` and is no longer a dangling FK — nothing to baseline there.
# ncbi_gene_id remains a cross-reference identifier (concept_type gene_xref_id), the
# bare prefix-stripped form of gene_id — not an FK to an HPO master (same pattern as
# reactome.ncbi_pathway_reactome.ncbi_gene_id). The checker over-flags *_id xref cols.
